name.en: Lumelar Vegetable Sheet Cutter Attachment for Stand Mixers, Cuts Long Sheets of Fruits and Vegetables, Wraps and Rolls, Includes Peel Blade, Hub Mounted

description.en: Cuts apples, cucumbers and potatoes into one long, even sheet for wraps, rolls and garnishes. It fits every Lumelar stand mixer's front hub.
